recipients.description: An array of objects representing the recipients of this welcome message.

richText.description: The rich text content of the welcome message, which may include formatting.

senders.description: An array of objects representing the senders of this welcome message.

text.description: The plain text content of the welcome message.

type.description: A string indicating the type of message, which is 'WELCOME_MESSAGE' by default.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when this welcome message was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

contentId.description: An integer representing the ID of the content associated with the template. This is a 64-bit integer.

crmObjectIds.description: An object that maps CRM object names to their respective IDs, where each ID is a 64-bit integer.

mappedTemplateId.description: An integer representing the ID of the mapped template. This is a 64-bit integer.

parameters.description: An object containing key-value pairs where each key is a parameter name and each value is a string representing the parameter value.

rootMicId.description: An integer representing the root MIC ID associated with the template. This is a 64-bit integer.

type.description: A string representing the type of the metadata, which is always 'WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_METADATA'.

label.description: A human-readable label for the quick reply, displayed to the user.

value.description: The actual content or data of the quick reply, represented as a string.

valueType.description: Indicates the type of the value, which can be either 'TEXT' or 'URL'.

description.description: A description of the media content.

id.description: A unique identifier for the media.

mediaTitle.description: The title of the media content.

mediaType.description: The type of media represented, such as 'PHOTO', 'VIDEO', 'CAROUSEL', etc. This is a required field.

mediaUrl.description: The URL where the media can be accessed.

mediaUrlString.description: A string representing the URL of the media.

thumbnailUrl.description: The URL of the thumbnail image for the media.

category.description: A string indicating the category of the error.

context.description: An object containing additional context about the error condition, with properties as arrays of strings.

errors.description: An array of ErrorDetail objects, providing further information about the error.

id.description: A string representing the unique identifier for the error.

links.description: An object mapping link names to associated URIs with documentation about the error or recommended remediation steps.

message.description: A string containing the error message.

status.description: The status of the error as a string.

subCategory.description: An object providing more specific details about the error category.

id.description: A string that uniquely identifies the system actor.

type.description: A string that specifies the type of actor, which is 'SYSTEM' for this component.

avatar.description: A string representing the URL of the visitor's avatar image.

email.description: A string containing the email address of the visitor.

id.description: A string representing the unique identifier for the visitor actor.

name.description: A string containing the name of the visitor.

type.description: A string indicating the type of actor, which is 'VISITOR' for this component.
